items.prompt: Portrait of a Hullbreaker hunter. A Hullbreaker, a huge hunched alien predator, plainly an alien and not an animal from Earth: no snout, no muzzle, no nose, no round furry ears, no fur on the face. Massive heavy rounded shoulders and thick forearms ending in heavy claws. A coarse shaggy mane of grey and black fur only over the neck and shoulders; the rest of the body is tough dark leathery hide. The face is bare and armoured in overlapping bony plates. The jaw is split vertically down the middle into two hinged halves that open sideways like mandibles, lined with teeth. Four small glowing eyes sit in one straight row across the brow, with small heat-sensing pits beside them. Ridged armour plates run down the back and over the shoulders. A scrap armour harness of hull plates torn from other ships is strapped over the body. Trophies are machine parts and hull plates, never skulls or bones. Not a bear, not a wolf, not a werewolf, not a human in a costume. The two jaw halves are closed, the split seam plain down the chin, four amber eyes in a row, calm and patient menace.
